scope: SDevice-only four-factor decomposition of the M15 electron SG transport response

factors.mobility_state: Vela edge-mobility response to replacing the baseline state inputs while holding the mobility drive fixed
factors.mobility_drive: Vela edge-mobility response to replacing the transport-cell-vector quasi-Fermi-gradient drive while holding the state inputs fixed
factors.bernoulli_weights: replacement of the variable-ni SG Bernoulli argument and weights
factors.carrier_population: replacement of the electron populations at the two edge endpoints

factorization.allocation: exact four-factor Shapley value over all 16 binary subsets
factorization.endpoint_policy: reuse production solved-equation electron-flux terms for the empty and full subsets
factorization.mixed_kernel_policy: evaluate variable-ni Bernoulli-density products in boost cpp_dec_float_100 arithmetic inside the production assembler
factorization.mobility_crosses: evaluate all state-drive combinations inside the same production assembler

adjoint_weighting.edge_weight: lambda_electron(node1)-lambda_electron(node0), with constrained continuity rows set to zero

interpretation_limits: The factors partition the Vela SG operator response; they are not native Sentaurus residual terms.
Mobility-drive contribution covers Vela transport-cell-vector GradQuasiFermi construction and its HFS response, not an unpublished Sentaurus HFS formula.
Mobility-state contribution may contain PhuMob, Enormal, carrier-population, electrostatic, and HFS interactions inside the Vela mobility evaluation.
Sub-fA relative responses remain conditioning-sensitive and are not used for headline attribution.
